item.title: SCP-5607:
item.content:encoded: While the article being an anti-drug PSA was funny, the email log drags on far past the point where "everyone wants PISS" stops being funny. Novote.

item.title: SCP-5607:
item.content:encoded:
Is this goofy as hell? Yes. No self-respecting shadow government organization would name a device PISS. Did I thoroughly enjoy it nonetheless? Yes. The log at the end drags a little in the middle, but the story overall keeps a consistent voltage and once again explores a lateral take on weaponizing anomalies.

In addition, this opens up a Project Crossover scenario where the Foundation manhunts Dale Gribble for hoarding copious quantities of SCP-5607-1.

+1

item.title: SCP-5160:
item.content:encoded:
This is a very pleasant SCP, featuring just the right level of weirdness, plus enjoyably unusual yet straightforwardly-justified containment procedures.

I hope someone designs a fanart logo for the charity at some point. I'd also enjoy seeing the hat.
